title: Shipping policy
answer: This practice shop does not send real parcels. Orders are simulated for learning, so there is no real delivery date or shipping charge.

title: Returns and cancellation policy
answer: A placed demo order can be cancelled from the order history. Cancellation changes its status and returns the demo items to inventory. No money is charged or refunded.

title: Payment policy
answer: Payments are simulated only. The practice shop never asks for or stores real card numbers, bank details, or payment credentials.

title: Discount code help
answer: The sample code WELCOME10 gives a 10 percent discount in the demo checkout. An invalid code leaves the basket unchanged so the customer can try again.
